title: Attendance register
description: Daily attendance tracking — arrivals, departures and absences

nav.closedNotice: {day} — the establishment does not open on this day.
nav.holidayNotice: {name} — the establishment is closed on this day.
nav.futureNotice: This day has not come yet — attendance cannot be recorded in advance.

tabs.presence: {present, plural, =0 {none of {total} present} one {# of {total} present} other {# of {total} present}}

counters.present: {count, plural, =0 {0 present} one {# present} other {# present}}
counters.absent: {count, plural, =0 {0 absent} one {# absent} other {# absent}}
counters.notMarked: {count, plural, =0 {0 not marked} one {# not marked} other {# not marked}}
counters.checkedOut: {count, plural, =0 {0 checked out} one {# checked out} other {# checked out}}
counters.ofTotal: {count, plural, =0 {no children enrolled} one {of # child} other {of # children}}
counters.reportedByParents: {count, plural, =0 {none reported by families} one {# reported by the family} other {# reported by families}}
counters.stillHere: {count, plural, =0 {nobody still here} one {# still here} other {# still here}}

timeDialog.title: Times — {name}
timeDialog.description: Manually set the check-in and check-out times for {date}.
timeDialog.hint: Leave a field empty to clear the corresponding time.

checkOutDialog.title: Check out {name}
checkOutDialog.description: Who is collecting the child? Pick someone from the list, or type a name.

toasts.bulkDone: {count, plural, one {# child marked present} other {# children marked present}}
toasts.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
toasts.closed: The establishment is closed on this day — nothing was recorded.
toasts.future: Attendance cannot be recorded for a day that has not come yet.

empty.title: No children
empty.description: No enrolled children in this class yet.

error.title: Could not load attendance
error.description: An error occurred while loading the data.

history.title: Attendance history
history.empty: No attendance data for this month.

journal.title: Daily journal
journal.description: Mood, meal and nap of every child present

photos.title: <name>{child}</name> · photos of {date}
photos.count: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}
photos.noConsent: The family has not answered the photo consent yet.
photos.tooLarge: This photo could not be reduced.

journal.publishDigest: Visible to the families right away; pushed to their phones inside the daily journal around <ltr>{time}</ltr>.
journal.publishNow: Visible to the families right away; sent to their phones now.
journal.emptyDescription: Mark arrivals in the register; the journal fills in after.

toasts.published: {count, plural, one {Journal published for # child} other {Journal published for # children}}

errors.future: That day has not come yet.
errors.closed: The establishment is closed that day.
errors.absent: This child is not marked present.
errors.profile: The journal does not apply to this class.
errors.consent: The family has not allowed photos.
errors.forbidden: Only the teaching team can fill in the journal.
